title: Asset
description: A media file of a site (image, video, audio, document, data) as a graph node: its bytes are identified by SHA-256 and stored once per site in the blob store under a content-addressed key, or kept elsewhere (`storage.kind: external`, e.g. a Zenodo or Hugging Face file). Pages, entries and terms refer to it by id (`ImageRef.assetId`, markdown `asset:<id>`). Snapshotted like every node, so a deleted asset's bytes stay while any snapshot references it (RFC-0004).

kind.description: What the file is, derived from the sniffed media type (never chosen by the client). `other` is allowed for external storage only.

mediaType.description: MIME type of the stored bytes as sniffed by the server (RFC 6838, lower case, no parameters), e.g. image/webp, text/csv. Served as Content-Type.

bytes.description: Size of the stored bytes. For external files: the size the source reports or the uploader declares.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the stored bytes (lower-case hex): the blob key, the public URL prefix, the ETag and the checksum shown with downloads. Unique per site. For external files see `storage.checksum`.

originalSha256.description: SHA-256 of the bytes as uploaded, present only when the server changed them (image metadata stripping).

slug.description: File name in the public URL, without extension: /media/<sha256[0..16]>/<slug>.<ext>. May change; the old URL then answers 301 to the new one.

title.description: Display title per locale (download lists, library search).

alt.description: Alternative text per locale. An `ImageRef.alt` that is not empty overrides it for one use.

decorative.description: The image carries no information and renders with alt="". Absent means false; the store never writes false.

caption.description: Caption per locale (plain text), the default for figures that show this asset.

credit.description: Who made it, as shown next to it (e.g. 'Photo: Ayşe Yılmaz').

status.description: active: listed and pickable. retired: hidden from the library and pickers and cannot be newly referenced; existing references keep rendering.

HttpsUrl.description: Absolute https URL without credentials, whitespace or backslashes.

AssetStorage.description: Where the bytes live. `blob`: in this deployment's blob store (R2 or the filesystem) under the content-addressed key media/<siteId>/<sha256>, derived and never stored, so the node is portable between backends. `external`: elsewhere, linked rather than hosted (large research files on Zenodo or Hugging Face).

url.description: Direct download URL of the file.

landingPage.description: Human page of the record the file belongs to (e.g. a Zenodo record or a Hugging Face dataset).

checksum.description: How `sha256` was obtained. computed: the server or `cloudhal media verify` streamed the URL and hashed it. declared: given by the person who linked it, not verified (shown as such).

verifiedAt.description: When the URL last produced bytes with this SHA-256 (checksum `computed`).

AssetImage.description: Intrinsic size and placeholders of an image. Present for every image stored as a blob.

animated.description: Animated GIF or WebP: never resized or re-encoded. Absent means false; the store never writes false.

blurhash.description: BlurHash of the image for themes that decode it client-side.

lqip.description: Low-quality placeholder: a raster data: URL of at most about 3 KB, shown while the image loads.

color.description: RFC-0028: the image's dominant colour, lower-case #rrggbb. Painted under the placeholder and in color-fill bars.

alpha.description: RFC-0028: the image may have transparent pixels (read from its header at ingest). Absent means opaque; transparent images never show the LQIP.

focal.description: RFC-0028: where the subject is, from the top-left corner as fractions of the width and height. Cover crops keep it in view.

AssetLicense.description: Terms the asset may be reused under: an SPDX license expression or a license URL.

id.description: SPDX license identifier or simple expression, e.g. CC-BY-4.0, CC0-1.0, MIT OR Apache-2.0, LicenseRef-AllRightsReserved.

AssetSource.description: How the asset came in. Immutable after create.

oneOf.title: UploadSource
oneOf.description: Bytes uploaded by a person (REST) or an agent (MCP upload_asset).

filename.description: Original file name as sent (never used as a storage key or served).

oneOf.title: FetchSource
oneOf.description: Bytes the server fetched from an https URL (MCP fetch_asset_url, Studio 'From URL') under the SSRF rules.

oneOf.title: ImportSource
oneOf.description: Created by a migration or importer (e.g. `cloudhal media import-urls` from an ImageRef.src).

from.description: The reference it was imported from: a URL or a site path.

oneOf.title: LinkSource
oneOf.description: An external file registered by URL without copying its bytes (storage.kind external).
